content.label: Examiner note - cryolite is an economics answer
content.body: Aluminium oxide melts at over 2000 degrees C; dissolved in molten cryolite the electrolysis runs at a much lower temperature. The cryolite is 'simply used to make the process more economical' - it is not a reactant and it is not reduced. Extraction methods are judged on cost as well as chemistry: that is what 'comment on a metal extraction process' invites.
